items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: With Son Leger? Well quite a while. I just remember the exact time I played with them.

ctx.x: Yeah. Let me turn it off before the knife comes home. So we have a pretty good idea what Chris played like from that. Yeah, that's it. Well how long were you with that first band before you went with Chris?
With Son Leger and? With Son Leger? Well quite a while. I just remember the exact time I played with them.
Would you say closer to a year, six months, two years?
